world.title: Iran urges UK, France to heed veteran diplomats’ warning on Israel
world.summary: A senior Iranian diplomat has called on the UK and France to take action against Israel, referencing an open letter from 102 former diplomats from both countries. The letter warns that Israeli policies in the occupied Palestinian territories are detrimental and urges these nations to reconsider their stance. Iran seeks a stronger response from Western powers regarding Israel's actions.

world.title: Europe Dodges a Rhine Crisis for the Worst Possible Reason
world.summary: Europe is currently avoiding a severe crisis due to weak fuel demand and crackers operating at approximately 70% capacity. Although the Rhine's water levels have slightly improved since mid-August, when they fell below 10 cm at Kaub, the situation remains precarious. Barges continue to struggle with carrying normal loads, impacting industrial operations along the river.

world.title: Trump shares image calling Hormuz 'new US territory'; Iran says strait 'closed'
world.summary: US President Donald Trump shared an image on Truth Social labeling the Strait of Hormuz as “NEW US Territory.” This statement escalates tensions between the US and Iran, with Iran asserting that the strait is “closed.” The Strait of Hormuz is a crucial waterway for global oil shipments, intensifying the ongoing standoff between the two nations.

business.title: 6X AI load, Rs 12,000 cr in orders: 2 firms wiring India and US data centres
business.summary: AI is significantly impacting the data centre industry, with one company focusing on India's development and another capitalizing on the US hyperscaler market. The US is projected to see commissioned capacity increase from 87 gigawatts to 233 gigawatts by 2030. The valuation gap between these firms raises questions about which presents a better investment opportunity in the evolving landscape.

business.title: From ACs to smartphones, wagons to defence: Inside 2 stocks building their next act
business.summary: Two companies are expanding beyond their traditional sectors, exploring new business opportunities. Unlike many firms that diversify within existing portfolios, these companies are creating independent growth engines. Their strategies involve venturing into various markets, such as consumer electronics and defense, aiming to establish new revenue streams. The success of these initiatives could significantly influence their future growth trajectories.

business.title: Beyond Reactors: 2 niche engineering stocks in India’s 100 GW nuclear race
business.summary: India's nuclear expansion, targeting 100 GW, presents opportunities for specialized pump manufacturers crucial for operational safety in nuclear plants. While these pumps may not garner as much attention as reactors or turbines, their importance is significant. Investors should consider factors like order visibility, qualification barriers, execution risks, and premium valuations when evaluating these niche engineering stocks.

technology.title: GTA 6 Suffers Fifth Straight Day of Gameplay Leaks
technology.summary: The alleged leaker of Grand Theft Auto 6 has released two additional gameplay videos, marking the fifth consecutive day of leaks. This occurs despite subpoenas from Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of Rockstar Games, seeking identifying information from Microsoft and Discord. The leaker, known as ‘CyberLeek,’ continues to share content related to the highly anticipated game.

technology.title: A 113 GB GTA 6 build is circulating online, but it appears to be fake
technology.summary: A 113GB build of GTA 6 is circulating on torrent sites, but it has been identified as fake and contains malware, posing risks to users' PCs and personal data. This incident follows a week of leaked gameplay footage and images shared by a user named Cyberleek, prompting Rockstar Games to issue DMCA notices to those distributing the content.

technology.title: Infinix HOT 70 Pro 5G India Launch Set for September 4 With Dynamic Shine Design
technology.summary: Infinix will launch the HOT 70 Pro 5G in India on September 4. The smartphone features an ultra-slim 7.85mm body and a Dynamic Shine Design. It will be available in four unique color options, each with distinctive finishes. Additionally, the rear panel includes an Active Matrix Cube lighting system, enhancing its interactive design.

sports.title: Cristiano Ronaldo becomes first player in the Football history to achieve unprecedented feat
sports.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first professional footballer to score in 25 consecutive league seasons. The 41-year-old Portuguese forward continues to extend his record, showcasing his longevity and consistent performance in football. This accomplishment adds to his already impressive career, further solidifying his status as one of the sport's all-time greats.

sports.title: ABF vs TKR Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: The Antigua and Barbuda Falcons (ABF) will compete against the Trinbago Knight Riders (TKR) in the Caribbean Premier League 2026. The match is scheduled for August 23, 2026, at 04:30 IST. As the season progresses, both teams aim for a strong performance, with predictions and betting tips available for fans and analysts to consider ahead of the match.

sports.title: Chinese robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m record in stunning Beijing sprint
sports.summary: A Chinese humanoid robot, Tiangong Ultra, won a 100m heat at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, completing the distance in 9.39 seconds. This performance surpassed Usain Bolt's long-standing record. Tiangong Ultra triumphed over Honor's Lightning, highlighting significant advancements in China's humanoid robotics sector and showcasing the potential future of sprinting with mechanical athletes.

health.title: Men’s health matters even before conception: Study
health.summary: A study published in Men’s Health journal emphasizes the importance of both men's and women's physical and mental health prior to conception. Researchers conducted a literature search across multiple databases to gather relevant studies, concluding that pre-conception health significantly impacts subsequent pregnancies and the health of children. This highlights the need for awareness regarding men's health before conception.

health.title: H1N1 surge: hospital footfall increases as doctors flag risks
health.summary: H1N1 cases are surging in Delhi, leading to increased hospital visits, particularly in outpatient departments. Doctors caution that vulnerable groups, including the elderly and those with pre-existing conditions, may face serious complications due to the viral infection. While most healthy adults recover without issues, the changing weather is contributing to the rise in cases and hospital footfall.

health.title: Chronic stress is more than a mental health problem: How it can raise blood pressure and put your kidneys at risk
health.summary: Chronic stress affects more than mental health, potentially raising blood pressure and risking kidney health. While stress does not directly cause kidney disease, it can lead to repeated increases in blood pressure and unhealthy lifestyle changes. Over time, uncontrolled high blood pressure may gradually damage the kidneys, highlighting the complex relationship between chronic stress and overall physical health.

science.title: Sweat may cool the body less than expected in hot, dry and windless conditions
science.summary: Sweat may be less effective at cooling the body in hot, dry, and windless conditions than previously thought. In still air, competing heat-driven and humidity-driven air currents near the skin can hinder sweat evaporation. This finding suggests that the risk of heat-related issues may increase in such environments, challenging existing heat models that underestimate these conditions' impact.

science.title: after NASA images show crater carved by a SpaceX rocket that slammed into the moon
science.summary: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter has captured detailed before-and-after images of a new crater on the moon, created by a SpaceX rocket collision. The agency released these photos on August 18, 2026, showcasing the impact area. This event marks a significant moment in space exploration, highlighting the effects of human activity on celestial bodies.

science.title: Moon Missions and Microbial Survival in Space
science.summary: China is set to launch its Chang'e-7 mission, its most complex lunar endeavor, to search for frozen water near the moon's south pole. Concurrently, President Trump has announced a policy to boost U.S. commercial space launches. Additionally, NASA research indicates that certain Earth microbes may endure the moon's harsh conditions, despite its extreme environment.

entertainment.title: 'Awarapan 2' box office collection Day 9: Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani starrer surpasses Rs 180 crore mark worldwide amid 'Batwara 1947' clash
entertainment.summary: 'Awarapan 2', featuring Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani, has surpassed Rs 180 crore in worldwide box office collections after nine days. The film leveraged nostalgia and revamped songs from the original 'Awarapan' to attract viewers. Its performance continues amid competition from 'Batwara 1947', indicating strong audience interest and effective marketing strategies employed by the filmmakers.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: August 23, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 23, 2026, Virgo individuals are encouraged to embrace new realizations and ideas, as their season begins. This period is marked by heightened energy and potential for personal growth. Virgos may feel a strong drive to pursue their ambitions, making it an opportune time for self-reflection and action. Happy birthday to all Virgos celebrating today.

entertainment.title: 'Vishwanath and Sons' box office collections day 9 vs 'DC': Suriya, Mamitha Baiju's film jumps 61.1%; Lokesh Kanagaraj film hits Rs 95.89 Cr worldwide
entertainment.summary: Suriya and Mamitha Baiju's film 'Vishwanath and Sons' saw a 61.1% increase in box office collections on its ninth day, continuing its successful theatrical run. The family drama performed well on its second Saturday, contributing to its overall earnings. In comparison, Lokesh Kanagaraj's film 'DC' has reached a total of Rs 95.89 crore worldwide.
